name: canli-research-mcp
description: Canli Capital's open research record: every paper, killed candidate, trial count and the live paper record.
long_description: Search and read Canli Capital's published research: strategy tests, killed candidates, literature reviews and feasibility protocols, with the count of hypotheses tried, the live paper-trading record and the chain that shows the record was not rewritten. Reads static files from canlicapital.com; no key or account. Each result carries its source's own limits. Paper execution only, not investment advice.

tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Find research papers by words in their titles and summaries

tools.description: The research topics and how many papers each holds

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: A paper's text as published, or one section of it

tools.name: trial_ledger
tools.description: How many hypotheses were tried, killed and survived

tools.description: The live paper-trading record and each sleeve's paper equity
